Venetoclax targets BCL-2 in chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL) by binding to the BCL-2 protein, which is an anti-apoptotic protein that helps cancer cells survive. By inhibiting BCL-2, venetoclax promotes apoptosis, or programmed cell death, in CLL cells. This disrupts the survival signals that the cancer cells rely on, leading to their death and reducing the progression of the disease.
